subject: planner: recognize order on common handle PK (#66645)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff relative to first parent (`git show 3032ee10`) touching `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` plus added planner casetest. The change extends `matchProperty` to treat non-unique secondary indexes on CommonHandle tables as physically ordered by `(index_cols, PK_cols)` so `ORDER BY` on clustered PK can be recognized (keep-order), with an explicit guard to skip the CommonHandle v0 + new collation + non-binary string-handle case to avoid incorrect ordering when merge-sort comparisons would operate on sortKey-encoded handle bytes. No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics issues found. Later history check up to `origin/master` shows no follow-up fix related to this change (`git log 3032..origin/master` only updates issue templates).
